name: IMPOSSIBLE Double Jump Obby
desc:
Welcome to the IMPOSSIBLE Double Jump Obby! 😈

In this obby, you get TWO JUMPS! ✌️
This makes a normal obby much easier, so this obby must get even HARDER! 👀

📈 Stages go from Easy (😁) to nil (👿).. will you beat nil? 💥

Like, ⭐ Favourite and:
Join the group for free skips: https://www.roblox.com/groups/34767400/JoinOrElse ⬅️

⚙️ CONTROLS:
- Quick Reset (R on keyboard)
- Shift Lock (Shift on keyboard)

🔴 YOUR PROGRESS SAVES SO YOU CAN REJOIN AND BE AT THE SAME STAGE YOU LEFT AT!
💯 All stages are 100% possible, as they have all been playtested!
